writerScope.stream: Native page order; choose actual OCR page where present; join selected page text with exactly two LF; complete declared nonblank coverage; preserve original source bytes and codepoint offsets
writerScope.lines: Split on LF; ECMAScript trim for classification only; CR is whitespace; retain original raw source for all quote and offset checks
writerScope.roleHeading: Exact roleTitleSource + whitespace + at + whitespace + employer + optional final period; /iu; employer starts L and contains only L/M/ASCII space/hyphen; employer <=100 UTF16 units; forbid scoped tokens across complete line
writerScope.contribution: One or two exact clauses with literal semicolon-space; optional one final period; choose rightmost valid using delimiter to match greedy object; trim must not change clause; no other semicolon/period/exclamation/question/colon, CR/LF, ASCII digits, quotes/backtick/curly quotes or forbidden token
writerScope.forbiddenBoundary: ECMAScript /word/iu membership from pinned scalar profile; ASCII case fold plus exact non-ASCII fold exceptions; no locale classes
writerScope.metadataWhitespace: Map each exact whitespace scalar to ASCII space and collapse consecutive spaces before heading/role matching; never normalize fact or citation bytes
writerScope.ambiguityKey: Case-sensitive scalar stream; each L/M scalar replaced by pinned NFD letter-only skeleton, other admitted punctuation unchanged; ECMAScript trim/collapse whitespace then remove optional one final period; exactly one closed contribution with target key; conservative collisions refuse
writerScope.continuation: Reject adjacent raw contribution lines separated by exactly LF or CRLF when predecessor lacks final period and next trimmed line begins built/created/developed in lower case; blank lines break adjacency
writerScope.location: Exactly one existing entry or bullet reference; no contact or section reference; a target bullet must have exactly one factId equal to target fact
writerScope.unsupported: Unknown lines, initial name/contact/URL, labelled contributions and bullet prefixes are not admitted by this initial decision scope; existing preview policy remains unchanged; full broader authoring remains incomplete
writerScope.rawRolePrerequisite: Additionally require the original ECMAScript-trimmed raw role line to match the frozen IR roleTitleSource + whitespace + at + whitespace + employer + optional final period before metadata whitespace collapse; compound full[- ]stack and machine learning retain their literal spaces. Normalization cannot turn an unknown source qualifier into a known role.

body.originalProof: Rebuild immutable selected original canonical/JD pair under current owned access; skip only live head equality; do not mutate context heads; captured command heads equal selected pair; Node verifies complete ordered draft/id and every command field
body.draftId: Opaque Native correlation only; never proof; Native independently rebuilds owned source, target, confirmation, source ranges, selected atomic positive JD relevance and exact replacement SHA
body.replay: Current owner/privacy/root/source/org access before exact shared-ledger replay; replay validates exact command/digest/event/scope/receipt before fresh-head conflict; another command under same key conflicts
body.fresh: Lock analysis and canonical head; require current selected canonical and latest saved JD pair for accept and reject; validate all original metadata and source independently; no caller proof boolean
body.accept: Atomic existing canonical edit then owner confirmation with exactly two revisions, candidate declaration and no direct source citations on changed wording, historical support in event, exact event/audit/receipt
body.reject: Atomic decision/event/audit without head movement; same fresh-pair rule
body.unknownOutcome: Manual retry only with byte-identical original command/key; no automatic new proposal/key or old protocol fallback
body.undo: Not supplied by accept/reject receipt; separately validate actual owned accepted v2 event/result and guarded rollback CAS before exposing undo
body.activation: Default off; new writer/helpers revoked from PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role until Native execution and explicit activation; metadata read grant only
body.numerics: No numeric score/proficiency or qualification authority; scoreValue and scoreDelta remain null
